scripts.cap:sync: npm run cap:config:local && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:sync:remote: npm run cap:config:remote && npx cap sync android && npm run cap:config:local
scripts.cap:open:android: npm run cap:config:local && npx cap open android
scripts.android:prepare: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-android-web-assets.mjs && npm run cap:sync
scripts.android:prepare:remote: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-android-web-assets.mjs && npm run cap:sync:remote
